lines.transliteration: mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਖੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਕਸਾਈਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਖੰਨੑਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: akhee prem kasaaeeaa har har naam pikha(n)nhi ||
lines.translation: The eyes which are attracted by the Lord's Love behold the Lord through the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕਰਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਦੇਖਦੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਢਿ ਦਿਚੰਨੑਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: je kar doojaa dekhade jan naanak kadh dicha(n)nhi ||2||
lines.translation: If they gaze upon something else, O servant Nanak, they ought to be gouged out. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਨੋ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jal thal maheeal poorano apara(n)par soee ||
lines.translation: The Infinite Lord totally permeates the water, the land and the sky.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਦਾ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jee ja(n)t pratipaaladaa jo kare s hoee ||
lines.translation: He cherishes and sustains all beings and creatures; whatever He does comes to pass.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਮੀਤ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: maat pitaa sut bhraat meet tis bin nahee koee ||
lines.translation: Without Him, we have no mother, father, children, sibling or friend.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਜਪਿਅਹੁ ਜਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghat ghat a(n)tar rav rahiaa japiahu jan koee ||
lines.translation: He is permeating and pervading deep within each and every heart; let everyone meditate on Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਜਪਹੁ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੁਨ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਸਭ ਲੋਈ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: sagal japahu gopaal gun paragat sabh loee ||13||
lines.translation: Let all chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the World, who is manifest all over the world. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਿ ਸਜਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਇਆ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh mile s sajanaa har prabh paaiaa ra(n)g ||
lines.translation: Those Gurmukhs who meet as friends are blessed with the Lord God's Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਤੂ ਲੁਡਿ ਲੁਡਿ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਵੰਞੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam salaahi too lud lud daragahi va(n)nj ||1||
lines.translation: O servant Nanak, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord; you shall go to His court in joyous high spirits. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭਸ ਦਾ ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har toohai daataa sabhas daa sabh jee tumhaare ||
lines.translation: Lord, You are the Great Giver of all; all beings are Yours.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਤੁਧੈ ਨੋ ਆਰਾਧਦੇ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh tudhai no aaraadhade daan dehi piaare ||
lines.translation: They all worship You in adoration; You bless them with Your Bounty, O Beloved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤੈ ਦਾਤਾਰਿ ਹਥੁ ਕਢਿਆ ਮੀਹੁ ਵੁਠਾ ਸੈਸਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har daatai daataar hath kadhiaa meehu vuthaa saisaare ||
lines.translation: The Generous Lord, the Great Giver reaches out with His Hands, and the rain pours down on the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਨੁ ਜੰਮਿਆ ਖੇਤੀ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)n ja(n)miaa khetee bhaau kar har naam samhaare ||
lines.translation: The corn germinates in the fields; contemplate the Lord's Name with love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak ma(n)gai daan prabh har naam adhaare ||2||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak begs for the Gift of the Support of the Name of his Lord God. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਛਾ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪੂਰੀਐ ਜਪੀਐ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ichhaa man kee pooreeai japeeai sukh saagar ||
lines.translation: The desires of the mind are satisfied, meditating on the Ocean of Peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਅਰਾਧੀਅਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤਨਾਗਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ke charan araadheeahi gur sabad ratanaagar ||
lines.translation: Worship and adore the Feet of the Lord, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the jewel mine.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਾਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਫਾਟੈ ਜਮ ਕਾਗਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: mil saadhoo sa(n)g udhaar hoi phaatai jam kaagar ||
lines.translation: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one is saved, and the Decree of Death is torn up.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜੀਤੀਐ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੈਰਾਗਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam padaarath jeeteeai jap har bairaagar ||
lines.translation: The treasure of this human life is won, meditating on the Lord of Detachment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਪਵਹੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਦੁਖ ਦਾਗਰੁ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: sabh pavahu saran satiguroo kee binasai dukh daagar ||14||
lines.translation: Let everyone seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru; let the black spot of pain, the scar of suffering, be erased. ||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਢੂੰਢੇਂਦੀ ਸਜਣਾ ਸਜਣੁ ਮੈਡੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau dhoo(n)dhe(n)dee sajanaa sajan maidai naal ||
lines.translation: I was seeking, searching for my Friend, but my Friend is right here with me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak alakh na lakheeai guramukh dehi dikhaal ||1||
lines.translation: O servant Nanak, the Unseen is not seen, but the Gurmukh is given to see Him. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਈ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਚੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak preet laaee tin sachai tis bin rahan na jaaee ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, I am in love with the True Lord; I cannot survive without Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: satigur milai ta pooraa paaeeai har ras rasan rasaaee ||2||
lines.translation: Meeting the True Guru, the Perfect Lord is found, and the tongue savors His Sublime Essence. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਸੁਣੈ ਕੋ ਉਚਰਿ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: koee gaavai ko sunai ko uchar sunaavai ||
lines.translation: Some sing, some listen, and some speek and preach.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam janam kee mal utarai man chi(n)diaa paavai ||
lines.translation: The filth and pollution of countless lifetimes is washed away, and the wishes of the mind are fulfilled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣਾ ਮੇਟੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavan jaanaa meteeai har ke gun gaavai ||
lines.translation: Coming and going in reincarnation ceases, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਤਰਹਿ ਸੰਗੀ ਤਰਾਹਿ ਸਭ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਤਰਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap tarahi sa(n)gee taraahi sabh kuta(n)b taraavai ||
lines.translation: They save themselves, and save their companions; they save all their generations as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੧੫॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak tis balihaaranai jo mere har prabh bhaavai ||15||1|| sudh ||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to those who are pleasing to my Lord God. ||15||1|| Sudh||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਕਾਨੜਾ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag kaanaRaa baanee naamadev jeeu kee ||
lines.translation: Raag Kaanraa, The Word Of Naam Dayv Jee:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸੋ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: aiso raam raai a(n)tarajaamee ||
lines.translation: Such is the Sovereign Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of Hearts;

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਦਰਪਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਬਦਨ ਪਰਵਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaise darapan maahi badan paravaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He sees everything as clearly as one's face reflected in a mirror. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਸੈ ਘਟਾ ਘਟ ਲੀਪ ਨ ਛੀਪੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: basai ghataa ghat leep na chheepai ||
lines.translation: He dwells in each and every heart; no stain or stigma sticks to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਜਾਤੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ba(n)dhan mukataa jaat na deesai ||1||
lines.translation: He is liberated from bondage; He does not belong to any social class. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਨੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਦੇਖੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਜੈਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: paanee maahi dekh mukh jaisaa ||
lines.translation: As one's face is reflected in the water,

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਕੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਬੀਠਲੁ ਐਸਾ ॥੨॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naame ko suaamee beethal aisaa ||2||1||
lines.translation: so does Naam Dayv's Beloved Lord and Master appear. ||2||1||
